steps.title: There is no button for it yet
steps.note: The app has no reset or log-out. Deleting an identity is manual today, and that is a gap rather than a design choice.

steps.title: In the browser
steps.note: Clear every localStorage key starting with nullnode. That removes the roster, the history and the sealed vault. Without your twelve words the account is then gone for good.

steps.title: On the relay
steps.note: Drop your address from relay/data/envelopes.json and relay/data/backups.json. Nothing in the protocol lets a client ask for that remotely.
